settings.allow_indexing: Let search engines index the Bingo pages
settings.allow_indexing_help: Off by default. Games and their cards need JavaScript, so there is little for a search engine to read.

permissions.moderate: Referee every Bingo game (confirm squares, rule on calls, edit and delete games)

gdpr.export: Bingo games you host, your cards and marks, your calls and disputes.
gdpr.delete: Your Bingo cards, calls and disputes are deleted. Games you host stay, without a host.

hub.title: Bingo
hub.lead: Play along with the big game, the ads, the keynote or the stream. Everyone gets their own card.
hub.load_error: Bingo could not be loaded. Please try again.
hub.empty: No games yet. Start one for the next big event!
hub.mine: {count, plural, one {You're one away!} other {You're # away}}

rules.confirmed: A Bingo counts as soon as the host has confirmed every square on the line.
rules.host: The host or a moderator checks each Bingo.
rules.trust: Honor system: a Bingo counts right away, and other players can dispute it.
rules.places: {count, plural, one {The first Bingo wins.} other {Prizes for the first # places.}}

manage.end_confirm: End this game now? Players can't mark or call anymore.
manage.delete_confirm: Delete this game, every card and every call? This can't be undone.

join.title: Get your card
join.help: Your card is dealt from {count} squares at random, so nobody else has the same one. Mark squares as they happen, and call Bingo when you complete a row, a column or a diagonal.
join.watch_only: You can watch this game, but you can't play.
join.hosting: You confirm squares as they happen and rule on Bingo calls, so you don't get a card in your own game.

card.label: Your Bingo card
card.call_it: You have Bingo on {line}! Call it!
card.refused: Your call on that line was not accepted. Keep going!
card.waiting: Your Bingo is waiting for the host.
card.won_unplaced: Your Bingo counts! The prizes were already taken.
card.not_started: The game hasn't started yet. You can look at your card.

calls.title: Bingo calls
calls.reject_help: Tell the player why, if you like. They'll be notified.
calls.dispute_help: What didn't happen? The host will take a look.

squares.title: Squares
squares.help_confirmed: Tap "It happened" as things happen. A Bingo counts as soon as all its squares are confirmed.
squares.help_host: Confirming squares helps you check calls. You accept or reject each Bingo yourself.
squares.help_trust: Confirming squares is optional here, but it helps players settle disputes.
squares.crowd: {count, plural, one {Marked by # player} other {Marked by # players}}

form.title: New Bingo game
form.in_discussion: Plays along in "{title}": calls and results are posted there.
form.name: Name
form.squares_help: At least {count}. Things that might happen: "Puppy in an ad", "Fumble", "One more thing". Each card gets a random 24 of them.
form.squares_locked: Players already have their cards, so squares can't be added, removed or moved. You can still fix the wording.
form.locked_count: Keep exactly {count} squares: players already have their cards.
form.template: Add ideas from a ready-made pack…
form.created: Your game is up! Look for it under the title.
